2024-11-06.name: Okaimono Panda!
2024-11-06.desc:
Okaimono Panda has a big heart and always gives 110% no matter what. They are also a bit of a shopaholic, which sometimes gets them into a spot of trouble...

Source: Rakuten

2024-11-06.name: Wangu Zui Qiang Zong
2024-11-06.desc:
A special scientific experiment, a wonderful adventure in different time and space.

Jun Changxiao came to the Xingyue Continent with the system and inherited an unknown small sect. He must build the sect into the No. 1 sect in the Xingyue Continent within a hundred years and recruit 100,000 disciples. If he fails to do so, the system will self-destruct and he will be finished with it.

In order to survive and return to his original time and space safely, he actively "founded a sect", taught and recruited disciples. The gang started with him as the "lone commander", and gradually grew to hundreds of people.

Under the leadership of Jun Changxiao, everyone built houses and planted crops, caught chickens and found dogs, and maintained peace in the area, helping the weak and fighting the strong at any time. The disciples in the sect had different personalities, and the funny Jun Changxiao got along well with everyone. There was endless joy in the warm big family. Everyone supported each other in a lively and positive atmosphere and grew up quickly. The cultivation of the sect was a long and arduous task, and Jun Changxiao led his disciples to explore up and down...

source: baike.baidu.com/googletranslate

2024-11-07.name: Wu Ni
2024-11-07.desc:
In Tianwu Continent, the strong are respected. Feng Hao, the eldest son of the Feng family, has a unique physique, but he is considered a useless cultivator and suffers humiliation! By chance, his body changes, allowing him to turn his life around! He uses strange crystals to forge his body and achieve a supreme body. When he controls the virtual martial arts, he will destroy the world and slash in all directions ...

source: baike.baidu.com/googletranslate

2024-11-08.name: Shingeki no Kyojin: The Last Attack
2024-11-08.desc:
Humanity lived quietly behind massive walls built to protect themselves from the threat of monstrous creatures called Titans. Their century of peace was shattered by an attack on their city that left a young child, Eren Yeager, motherless and vowing revenge on the titans. Years after joining the Survey Corps, Eren finds himself facing a deadly foe, and ultimately gaining a special ability that unveils a new truth about the world he knows... After venturing beyond the walls and separated from his comrades, Eren finds himself inspired by this new truth and plots the "Rumbling," a terrifying plan to eradicate every living thing in the world. With the fate of the world hanging in the balance, a motley crew of Eren's former comrades and enemies scramble to halt his deadly mission. The only question is, can they stop him?

Source: Crunchyroll

2024-11-11.name: Shanhai Fu Mo Lu
2024-11-11.desc:
A civilization that disappeared in the dust, the ancient bosses sought their own way to become emperors. Jiang Hao, a modern young man who was originally a chess piece, stepped into the prehistoric wilderness in order to find the whereabouts of his father. With his incomplete "power bank" totem, he fought with people, from primitive tribes to the mysterious ancient city, he fought his way out; he fought with the earth, crossed the wilderness, hunted ancient beasts, and learned the ancient and mysterious totem witchcraft from the beasts; he fought with the sky, and the magic light from the sky suddenly appeared, wanting to devour this magnificent six wastelands. He went upstream, ignited himself, turned into the sun, and fought with the devil! He was shaking the world, but he didn't know that the shackles of fate had already trapped him, and his father's smile was still lingering.

source: MAL

2024-11-14.name: Zanting! Zhi Xu Chongzu
2024-11-14.desc:
On an unknown continent, there is a city called Satellite City No. 9. In this city, a screw straightening worker named Rui Li at the screw factory gradually realizes the unreality of the city in her monotonous daily work. With the help of a mysterious character named "Anull", Rui Li gains the superpower of "transformation" and becomes the thief "Sirius", secretly taking action to escape from here. When the truth of the world finally unfolds before her eyes, Rui Li discovers that her real battle has just begun.

source: themoviedb.org

2024-11-17.name: Qia Tongxue Shaonian
2024-11-17.desc:
In 1913, in Changsha, Hunan, the famous educator Kong Zhaoshou became the principal of Hunan First Normal School. He vigorously carried out new-style education reforms and hired outstanding Chinese and foreign teachers represented by Yang Changji, and the school was completely renewed. The brand-new First Normal School attracted many students to apply for the exam. The 19-year-old Mao Zedong was admitted to this thousand-year-old institution with the first place.
In their common study life, Mao Zedong, Cai Hesen, Xiao Zisheng and other aspiring young people forged friendships. At the same time, female students such as Tao Siyong, Xiang Jingyu and Yang Kaihui from Hunan Private Zhounan Women's Normal School also came together with them because of their similar interests. A reading club composed of advanced young students became a bond for their learning, communication and ideological collision.
However, the turbulent situation disrupted the students' campus life. In the struggle against Sino-Japanese friendship, the warlord Tang Xingming forced Principal Kong to leave by force, and Mao Zedong was almost arrested. The cruel reality made Mao Zedong waver in his belief in saving the country through education and reformism.

source: bgm.tv\googletranslate

2024-11-22.name: Zhen Hun Jie 4
2024-11-22.desc:
Cao Yanbing and his party were framed by the Tiangang Dragon Chess Generals led by Huangfu Longdou for the destruction of the Luhua Ancient Building, and all of them were wanted by the Spirit Realm. When passing through "Tianwu Street" and "Fenglei Street", they encountered the third knight Honglian and the tenth knight Kemila of the Kingdom Organization respectively. Afterwards, Cao Yanbing was deliberately arrested to the death row "Qianji Black Brake" guarded by the Hall of Heroes in order to find the whereabouts of his mother. In order to save Cao Yanbing, his companions, with the help of many parties, gathered in the Hall of Heroes from all sides and launched a wonderful battle of heroes.

source: bgm.tv/googletranslate

2024-11-29.name: Gekijou Soushuuhen Genjitsu no Yohane: Sunshine in the Mirror

2024-11-30.name: Ka Tu
2024-11-30.desc:
Hundreds of years ago, a sudden meteorite impact caused the entire world to collapse into two mutually symbiotic and absolutely isolated continents. In order to save the human civilization that was in danger, hundreds of scientists from the original continent, led by Rosenberg, gathered the strength of various countries to develop a new energy supply device (card). The protagonist Chen Mu went from being a weak, helpless, poor and helpless boy to experiencing a series of adventures full of struggles and hardships. He did not give up or retreat, but still relied on his kind and tolerant nature, his own outstanding efforts and the enthusiastic help of his relatives and friends around him. He finally broke through many obstacles and grew into a righteous, moral and capable positive leader.

source: bgm.tv/googletranslate
